Hello!

Imnotbatmanstopaskin thought it would be a nice idea to have a stickied thread for frequently asked questions and I agreed. here we'll try to answer any questions anyone might have when getting started buying/selling comic codes.

if you have any questions about what to do, please ask them here so that everyone may learn from them.

*how do I sell my codes?

oh, that's an easy one. get your comics together, if it is a back issue make sure you check when it is set to expire. I can't speak for d.c. but marvel had it in print to the top right of the code. sometimes ones that have expired are still redeemable. marvel gives a little leeway but you should check the code at marvel redeem to be sure. if your codes are good, it is then time to post. start a new discussion with the release date (ex. have releases for 07/08, want $1 via PayPal) or the titles (ex. have amazing Spider-Man and uncanny avengers, want trade via comixology) of the books that you have. hopefully you'll get some replies! once you do make sure to edit your list so that people don't mistakenly think those books are available. once the selections are agreed on you should exchange all other information in a private conversation. I ask for money through PayPal, using their friends and family option so that they don't take a fee. I ask the buyer to include a note that'll help me know who the payment is from and once I receive the payment I send the codes through the private message. please, do not send them through thread that you posted.

*how much should I charge?

from what I've seen, a dollar a code is about the usual for new releases. That is in no way a set price for what you would like to list in your threads. they're yours, you may charge what you like. But remember the real meaning of "the customer is always right" and about cost and demand. (the former being, if the customer is unwilling to pay it then your price is too high. And the latter that if there is no demand, you can't charge a high price.)

*how do I buy codes?

that's an easy one as well! swing by regularly to see what sellers are offering. of course, wednesday is a good day to check. peruse their listings and see if there is anything you would like, let them know and then take it to a private conversation. make sure the seller is asking for the sale to be made through a reputable site and that you do not give away any of your financial information. I don't we'll have any Nigerian princes here but you never know.

*how do I make sure I don't miss an issue/a sale?

some sellers might choose to offer subscriptions. if you are interested in offering them, make sure to mention it in your thread. if you are interested in one, make sure to ask a seller. personally I have only given subscriptions to one person and it was only because he offered to pay extra.

*how do I know if who I am selling to/buying from is on the up and up?

That's a difficult one. one thing you can be sure of is that I'll never take your money and run off to Mexico, like a comic code cartel lord (super promise). the exchanges here are based on trust. if someone breaks that trust please let me (or any future moderators I might have helping) know. the best thing to do is to remember another person is on the other side of the transaction and probably worked hard to buy the comics they are selling/buying and the world is only as good as we treat one another.

if you happen to have any other questions, please feel free to ask.

thank you!
